# GitHub Copilot Instructions

The repository-root [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) is the canonical instruction
file for this repository. Read and follow it before proposing or making
changes. Apply any more specific `AGENTS.md` found below the repository root to
files in that subtree.

Do not duplicate repository guidance here; update `AGENTS.md` so all coding
agents receive the same instructions.
